name: media-center-sync
description: Sync gateway between media services — local and remote, peer to peer

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix packages/shared install && npm --prefix packages/api install && npm --prefix packages/front install
scripts.ci:all: npm --prefix packages/shared ci && npm --prefix packages/api ci && npm --prefix packages/front ci
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm --prefix packages/api run build && npm --prefix packages/front run build
scripts.dev: npm run dev:api & npm run dev:front
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm --prefix packages/api run typecheck && npm --prefix packages/front run typecheck
scripts.lint: npm --prefix packages/api run lint && npm --prefix packages/front run lint
scripts.test: npm --prefix packages/api test && npm --prefix packages/front test
